verdict.rationale: Apple's own marketing references gaming only vaguely (the ray-tracing engine and a mention that 'games like Control look more compelling') with no frame-rate numbers, cache, or clock-boost specifics tied to gaming, and there is no independent game benchmark data anywhere in the pack; community comments only raise open questions about competitiveness with gaming PCs rather than concrete contradicting benchmarks. missing for 10: independent FPS/game-benchmark corroboration, vendor frame-rate or clock/cache gaming specs, hands-on gaming performance reviews.
